content: Pharmacologic therapy for adults with type 2 diabetes, as recommended by the American Diabetes Association (ADA), should be tailored and adjusted based on the effectiveness of the treatment in achieving glycemic and metabolic targets. Treatment options include intensifying pharmacologic interventions, such as the use of GLP-1 receptor agonists or SGLT2 inhibitors, among other medications. Additionally, lifestyle modifications should be implemented to support therapeutic goals. If individual glycemic and metabolic targets remain unmet despite these measures, combination pharmacologic therapies should be considered. In certain cases, metabolic surgery may also be an appropriate option to achieve desired outcomes.
